input.quote: a) IBM may perform process audits at MSL's or an MSL Related Company's Work Center or MSL's subcontractors' facilities to assure that identified IBM specifications have been complied with.
input.rationale: Every audit, inspection and verification right in the Agreement runs in our favour as customer: Section 7.0 (process audits at MSL's Work Centers), Section 13.1/21.2/21.3 (audit and inspection of consigned Products and IBM tooling), Section 24.1 ("IBM retains the right to audit"), Attachment 6 Section 4.0 (IBM/MS monitoring and inspection of MSL software installation locations) and Attachment 6 Appendix A Section 4 (audit of MSL's and its Subsidiaries' books, records and facilities on 45 days' notice, by an independent auditor, at IBM's/MS's cost unless material discrepancies are found). Section 16.14 (Records) is mutual record-keeping only and confers no audit right. There is no reciprocal right for MSL to audit, inspect or verify IBM's premises, records, systems or usage, and no remote access to our systems is granted, so nothing binds us on frequency, notice, cost or system access. Compliant with the preferred position; no redline required.
